lessons.title: Padding, truncation, and batch length
lessons.intro:
Hugging Face Transformers 4.57 API baseline; PyTorch backend. Assumes Python functions, collections, and imports. Standard aliases: np=numpy, plt=matplotlib.pyplot, torch=PyTorch. Snippets are independent; stated model/tokenizer/file fixtures are assumed. The tutor never downloads models or executes learner code. Padding aligns sequence lengths; truncation limits long sequences. padding=True pads to the longest sequence in the batch, not necessarily max_length. padding="max_length" requests a fixed padded width. A valid pad token is required for tokenizers that do not define one.

lessons.title: ModelOutput objects and task-dependent shapes
lessons.intro:
Hugging Face Transformers 4.57 API baseline; PyTorch backend. Assumes Python functions, collections, and imports. Standard aliases: np=numpy, plt=matplotlib.pyplot, torch=PyTorch. Snippets are independent; stated model/tokenizer/file fixtures are assumed. The tutor never downloads models or executes learner code. Outputs expose named fields whose presence depends on the model and requested options. Sequence classification logits commonly have shape batch-by-labels; causal LM logits are batch-by-sequence-by-vocabulary. Raw logits are not normalized probabilities. Avoid relying on positional tuple indices when optional fields can change.
